descriptions: This Arab West Report Interview Documentation Project dataset consists of 8 audio recordings (5 items) on Yemen and the kidnapping of foreigners in the country in 1999.
The summaries of all the audio recordings are written in English. Arabic, Dutch, and English are used in the interviews.
